items.exampleEn: I genuinely believe this plan will work.
items.exampleZh: 我真心相信這個計畫行得通。

items.exampleEn: The children behaved appropriately at the museum.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們在博物館裡舉止很得體。

items.exampleEn: The dog came in with muddy paws.
items.exampleZh: 那隻狗帶著沾滿泥巴的腳掌走進來。

items.exampleEn: Being late three times a week is unacceptable.
items.exampleZh: 一週遲到三次是不能接受的。

items.exampleEn: The company made a swift decision to close the store.
items.exampleZh: 那家公司迅速決定關閉那家店。

items.exampleEn: The decorative tiles on the kitchen wall came from Spain.
items.exampleZh: 廚房牆上的裝飾磁磚是從西班牙來的。

items.exampleEn: Letters written by hand are uncommon these days.
There was a gradual rise in prices last year.

items.sentenceEn: The hotel staff responded appropriately when the guest complained.
items.sentenceZh: 客人抱怨時，飯店員工的應對很得當。

items.audioEn: The bus service was swift: we got to the airport in twenty minutes.
items.audioZh: 公車服務很快：我們二十分鐘就到了機場。

items.sentenceEn: She was genuinely happy to see her old friends again.
items.sentenceZh: 她再見到老朋友時真的很開心。

items.sentenceEn: Snow is uncommon in this part of the country.
items.sentenceZh: 這個國家的這一帶很少下雪。

items.stemEn: He hit another player, which is ____ behavior, so the referee sent him off.
items.stemZh: 他打了另一名球員，這是無法接受的行為，所以裁判把他趕出場了。

items.stemEn: These small lights are only ____; they don't give much light.
items.stemZh: 這些小燈只是裝飾用的，不太會發光。

items.passageEn: Last Sunday, our class helped clean the bank of the river near our school. It had rained all week, so the path was muddy, and we had to dress appropriately in boots and old clothes. We all squeezed into one small bus to get there. Our teacher said that throwing trash into the river is unacceptable, and she was genuinely shocked by how much plastic we found. We also found a decorative plate that someone had lost, which made everyone laugh. Seeing wild ducks is uncommon in the city, but we saw two. The river is getting cleaner, but the change is gradual. The change in weather, however, was swift: after lunch, the sun came out and dried the path.
items.passageZh: 上週日，我們班去幫忙清理學校附近的河岸。那一週一直下雨，小路很泥濘，所以我們得穿上雨鞋和舊衣服，打扮得合宜一點。我們全部擠進一輛小巴士過去。老師說，把垃圾丟進河裡是不能接受的行為，她看到我們撿到那麼多塑膠，真的很震驚。我們還撿到一個有人掉的裝飾盤，讓大家都笑了。在城市裡很少看到野鴨，但我們看到了兩隻。河水正在變乾淨，但變化是漸進的。不過，天氣倒是變得很快：午餐後太陽出來，把小路曬乾了。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼大家要穿雨鞋和舊衣服？
options: 下了一整週雨，路很泥濘
老師規定所有人都要穿制服

questions.questionZh: 河水變乾淨的速度怎麼樣？

referenceEn: There has been a gradual improvement in her English.
Her English is showing gradual improvement.
rubricZh: gradual 的用法，例如 a gradual improvement、gradual progress 等
時態合理（例如 has been、is showing 等）

items.promptZh: 我弟弟踢完足球後，褲子上全是泥巴。
referenceEn: My brother's pants were all muddy after he played soccer.
After playing soccer, my little brother's pants were completely muddy.
rubricZh: muddy 指「沾滿泥的」（例如 were all muddy、completely muddy 等）
「褲子」可寫，例如 trousers、pants 等；「足球」可寫，例如 football、soccer 等
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 were、are 等）
